title: MotionByDk Pro Suite v3.7.0 Released!
message: Integrated native Liquid Glass plugin, 3D Carousel stability overhaul (zero freeze / zero crash), and universal AE support.
changelog: 💧 Liquid Glass Plugin: Native glass distortion effect with 1-click Mac (.plugin) & Windows (.aex) auto-installers
⚡ 3D Carousel Architecture Overhaul: Native ExtendScript engine with 0% CPU lockup and 0% crash on Create
🛡️ Non-Blocking Error Feedback: Replaced all AE modal alerts with non-blocking status bar feedback
🌐 Universal Language Support: Expression engine compatible with all After Effects language editions
🎨 Dynamic Theme UI: Liquid Glass button syncs with all 6 color themes
Speed Graph vs Value Graph Dual-Overlay engine with velocity ghost curve
Dynamic UI Theme Switcher (Orange, Cyan, Violet, Emerald, Rose, Titanium)
In-Panel Detachable Floating Palettes & 1-Click Reset Layout
